q.t: The variety of plants and animals in a region is its…
q.e: Biodiversity is the variety of life in a region.

q.t: A mango plant is a…
q.e: Tall, with a hard, thick, woody stem.

q.t: A rose plant is a…
q.e: Medium height, hard thinner stem, branches near the ground.

q.t: A tomato plant is a…
q.e: Short, with a soft green stem.

q.t: A pumpkin plant that spreads along the ground is a…
q.e: Weak stem that creeps along the ground.

q.t: A money plant that needs support is a…
q.e: Weak stem that climbs with support.

q.t: The place where a plant or animal lives is its…
q.e: A habitat provides food, water, air and shelter.

q.t: A cactus stores water in its…
q.e: That helps it survive in the desert.

q.t: Frogs live…
o: Both on land and in water
q.e: Amphibians live in both.

q.t: Who is called the 'Birdman of India'?
q.e: He documented birds and their habitats across India.

q.t: Net-like veins on a leaf are called…
q.e: Like hibiscus — a net either side of a middle vein.

q.t: Banana and grass leaves have…
q.e: Their veins run side by side.

q.t: One main root with side roots is a…
q.e: Mustard and hibiscus have taproots.

q.t: Grass has…
q.e: A bunch of similar thin roots.

q.t: A chickpea seed splits into two parts. It is a…
q.e: Di = two cotyledons.

q.t: Maize has a single cotyledon. It is a…
q.e: Mono = one.

q.t: Why is a deodar tree cone-shaped with sloping branches?
q.e: It's adapted to snowy mountains.

q.t: Special features that help living things survive in a place are…
q.e: Adaptations suit an organism to its habitat.

q.t: Ponds, rivers and oceans are…
q.e: Aquatic = in water.

q.t: Project Tiger began in…
q.e: To protect the Bengal tiger. Cheetah reintroduction began in 2022.

q.t: A plant has parallel venation. Its roots are most likely…
q.e: Monocot → parallel venation → fibrous roots travel together.

q.t: A plant has a taproot. Its leaves most likely show…
q.e: Dicot → reticulate → taproot.

q.t: Why is it useful that these features travel together?
o: You can predict roots from leaves without digging
q.e: One look at a leaf tells you about the roots and seed.

q.t: Camels in Rajasthan have long legs with wide hooves to…
q.e: Wide hooves spread the weight on soft sand.

q.t: Ladakh camels have two humps and long hair because…
o: They live in a cold desert
q.e: Long hair keeps them warm; humps store food for winter.

q.t: Camels lose very little water because they…
o: Don't sweat and make little urine and dry dung
q.e: That lets them go many days without drinking.

q.t: Rhododendrons on windy peaks are shorter with smaller leaves to…
q.e: Smaller and shorter means less wind damage.

q.t: Two students group the same plants differently. Which is true?
o: Both can be right — they chose different features
q.e: The useful question is which feature answers your question.

q.t: Why does biodiversity vary from region to region?
o: Conditions vary, so different adaptations survive
q.e: Only living things with the right adaptations survive in each place.

q.t: Why did the Great Indian Bustard decline?
q.e: Damaging a habitat destroys home, food and resources.

q.t: Wheat has parallel-veined leaves. Predict its seed type and roots:
q.e: Parallel venation goes with monocot seeds and fibrous roots.

q.t: Sadabahar has net-like veins. Predict:
q.e: Reticulate → dicot → taproot.

q.t: A tree and a shrub both have hard brown stems. How can you tell them apart?
o: A shrub branches close to the ground; a tree higher up
q.e: Trees branch higher up the thick trunk.

q.t: Why do plants and animals in a habitat depend on each other?
o: Trees give food and shelter; animals spread seeds
q.e: Every member has a role.

q.t: A Ladakh camel's humps shrink in late winter because…
o: The stored food is being used up
q.e: Humps store food for the lean season.

q.t: Janaki Ammal helped save which place?
q.e: The Save Silent Valley movement stopped a dam on the Kunthipuzha river in Kerala.

q.t: Salim Ali helped preserve…
q.e: He also helped preserve Ranganathittu Bird Sanctuary.

q.t: A fish has a streamlined body and fins because it…
q.e: This shape slips easily through water.

q.t: A pigeon walks and flies using…
q.e: Animals can be grouped by movement and body parts used.

q.t: A snake moves by…
q.e: Snakes have no legs; they crawl.
